sourceFitAssessment.reasoning: The two selected-role tracks distinguish cell-cycle progression around DNA copying from initiation and elongation of RNA production. CDK7 cross-roles and activation of other CDKs are explicitly retained. The G1/S/G2-M sketch is a selected overview, not an exclusive assignment or complete cycle. RB presence is distinguished from circuit function; reversible arrest, cell death, marrow protection and clinical tumor control remain distinct. The linked unchanged cycle pair gives phase and DNA-content context but lacks transcription jobs, so this narrow owner extension fits the exact task.
